title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Assumption Funding Fee, Processing Fee Limit and Release Standard
content:
When a buyer assumes a loan backed by the VA Home Loan Guaranty, the buyer pays an assumption funding fee stated as a percent of the loan balance, the servicer may charge a processing fee up to a stated maximum, and each program states whether a release of liability requires the buyer to qualify and assume the obligations.

## Terms by program

| Program | Assumption funding fee paid by the buyer (% of the loan balance) | Most processing fee a servicer may charge (USD) | Release requires the buyer to qualify and assume the obligations |
|---|---|---|---|
| VA Interest Rate Reduction Refinance Loan (IRRRL) | 0.5 | 300.00 | Yes |
| VA Manufactured Home Loan | 0.5 | 300.00 | Yes |
| VA Purchase Loan (10% or More Down) | 0.5 | 300.00 | Yes |
| VA Purchase Loan (5% to Less Than 10% Down) | 0.5 | 300.00 | Yes |
| VA Purchase Loan (Less Than 5% Down) | 0.5 | 300.00 | Yes |
| VA Cash-Out Refinance Loan | 0.5 | 300.00 | Yes |
| Native American Direct Loan (NADL) | 0.5 | 300.00 | Yes |

## Hypothetical illustration

On an assumed loan with a hypothetical balance of 240,000.00 dollars, the buyer's assumption funding fee is 240,000.00 multiplied by 0.5 and divided by one hundred, or 1,200.00 dollars. A servicer processing that assumption may charge up to 300.00 dollars; a processing charge of 300.00 dollars is within the limit and one of 300.01 dollars is not.
